What's at stake on June 18

The Evergreen Public Library serves thousands of neighbors every month — students doing homework, job-seekers using computers, retirees attending programs, parents bringing their kids to story time. Measure L secures stable funding to keep these services running.

What a YES vote protects

  • Evening & Weekend Hours Keep the library open until 8pm weekdays and all day Saturdays and Sundays
  • Children's Programming Story time, summer reading, after-school programs, and youth literacy events
  • Computer Access & Internet Free public computers and Wi-Fi for job applications, benefits, and learning
  • Homework Help & Job Search Staff-led tutoring, resume workshops, and one-on-one career assistance

Without Measure L, the library will be forced to:

  • Cut 18 hours per week of open hours
  • Close entirely every Sunday
  • Eliminate the after-school homework help program
  • Reduce summer youth programming by 40%
  • Delay critical building repairs, including the leaking roof in the children's wing
  • Freeze hiring, leaving the library understaffed
